name: Asuka ~Ayako-chan to Hokenshitsu~
original_name: あすか ～綾子ちゃんと保健室～
source:
Ayako-chan feels bad at a gym and goes to school's health room right in her sportswear. There she meets her classmate who she likes. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
绫子在体育馆感到不适，便穿着运动服去了学校的保健室。在那里，她遇见了自己喜欢的同班同学。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
